error.message:
Expected upstream_failure: R odbc treats POSIXlt lists as raw-vector lists and fails before calling ODBC. Reference: https://github.com/r-dbi/odbc/blob/v1.4.2/src/odbc_result.cpp. Reproducer: repros/r-contract.R.
Reported FAILED: Error in `result_bind(res@ptr, params, batch_rows)`: RAW() can only be applied to a 'raw', not a 'double'
